scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @techzone/recruitment-public && npm run build --workspace @techzone/recruitment-admin && npm run build --workspace @techzone/recruitment-demo
scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web dev:public dev:admin
scripts.build:ui: npm run build --workspace @techzone/recruitment-public && npm run build --workspace @techzone/recruitment-admin
scripts.deployment:test:session: RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/create-test-session.mjs && (RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/schedule-test-session-cleanup.mjs || (RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/cleanup-test-session.mjs && exit 1))
scripts.deployment:test:browser-account: RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/create-test-browser-account.mjs && (RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/schedule-test-session-cleanup.mjs || (RECRUITMENT_DEPLOY_ENV=deployment/recruitment.test.env node scripts/cleanup-test-session.mjs && exit 1))
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @techzone/recruitment-backend && npm run test --workspace @techzone/recruitment-public && npm run test --workspace @techzone/recruitment-admin
scripts.verify: npm run docs:generate && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run docs:generate && npm test && npm run build
